classification: Bounded pilot on original uniform BCS, L12 G2. Training at t1; primary comparison t2.15. These physical conditions have already been inspected in earlier rounds.
models: radial pair-CC plus common collective two-transfer cluster
direct/witness/Hamiltonian-source extra connected two-transfer modes q=1,2,4
same_initial_state: Exact Fermi sea at t0 for all models; only training-time geometry differs.
radial_control: Every transfer-count sector has an independent complex multiplier, so all count-sector Ehrenfest equations are represented in the tangent space, subject to the declared numerical cutoff.
new_forecast_gate: Only if a canonical-specific improvement survives this pilot and conventional Hamiltonian-source controls, freeze a new-parameter test.
